dealer_gex_estimate.diagnostic_reason: Complete positive-OI coverage; current regime follows signed GEX at current spot

methodology.label: Estimated signed dealer GEX; not observable dealer positioning
methodology.dealer_position_assumption: Dealers net short calls and net long puts relative to customers
methodology.gamma_model: Black-Scholes spot gamma with r=0 and q=0
methodology.spot_input: Most recent valid Deribit BTC index_price in the collected option chain
methodology.open_interest_units: Deribit BTC option open_interest is BTC; contract_size is not multiplied again
methodology.gex_units: USD per 1% BTC spot move = gamma * OI_BTC * spot^2 * 0.01
methodology.flip_method: Revalue all covered contracts from 50% to 150% of current spot on 201 equally spaced points; linearly interpolate sign changes
methodology.regime_rule: Sign of aggregate estimated dealer GEX at current spot: positive=long_gamma, negative=short_gamma, approximately zero=zero_gamma
methodology.not_retailinterest: Independent estimate; does not scrape or depend on RetailInterest

assumptions.open_interest_unit: BTC base currency as reported by Deribit
